title: Almost-every-level convergence of superlevel-set measures
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, and μ, μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) Borel measures on ℝ^P such that (a) μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; (b) limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) for every compact K ⊆ U; (c) μ(G) ≤ liminf_j μ_j(G) for every open G ⊆ U (lim sup and lim inf in [0, ∞]). Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U, where tsupport g := closure{x : g(x) ≠ 0}. Then for almost every t ∈ (0, ∞) with respect to Lebesgue measure restricted to (0, ∞), μ_j({x : g(x) > t}) → μ({x : g(x) > t}) in [0, ∞] as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs j G) atTop) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), Tendsto (fun j => μs j {x | t < g x}) atTop (𝓝 (μ {x | t < g x}))
